Hi Michael,

I'm sorry. You asked on Friday and the weekend has gone by with nothing from us, and that is not good enough for a claim we have already approved.

Where it stands: your warranty claim is approved and the return is logged under reference Shop····. The only outstanding piece is buying the prepaid, duties paid label for the UK to Rotterdam route, which has to be purchased by a colleague rather than from my side. I have put it in front of them as the first thing of the day, and they start at 10am Eastern today. The label comes to you by email at this address.

Please write Shop···· on the outside of the box when you pack the S1. As soon as the unit reaches us, the new Nexus S1 with the UK plug goes out to you at no cost.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Hi Michael,

You're right to be annoyed, and I'm sorry. You logged this nearly three weeks ago, you did the diagnosis work yourself, we approved the claim, and you still have no label. That is on us, not on you.

Here is the honest position. Your return is approved and sits under reference Shop····. The label for (address hidden) back to our Rotterdam warehouse has to go on the duties paid service, and buying that one is above what I can do from my side, so it needs a colleague to press the button. I have marked it urgent and put it at the top of the queue for when they open at 10am Eastern today, and the label comes straight to this address.

For the wait, I've made you a code for your next order, HD-••••••, $50 off, yours alone and valid on orders over $200.

Once the S1 reaches us, the new UK unit ships to you at no cost.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Again thank you for that, definitely not your fault if your colleagues are
not acting. It was an expensive device otherwise I would not be so bothered.

Kind regards

Michael H.

Hi Michael,

Thank you for that, it's kind of you. And you're right that it's an expensive unit, which is exactly why it should not have taken this long.

Nothing else is needed from you. The label is flagged as urgent for the moment the team opens at 10am Eastern, and it comes straight to this address with your reference Shop···· on it. Write that reference on the outside of the box when you pack the S1.

I'll keep an eye on it and let you know as soon as it moves, and again when your replacement is on its way.

Kind regards,
Sarah

I've checked again just now, and I'm sorry to say the label still has not been bought. No return has been opened against your order yet, so nothing has moved since we last spoke. You should not be chasing this a fourth time.

The team is online now, and I have put it in front of them again, marked urgent, with the exact route and cost so there is nothing left to work out. A colleague is picking it up today and the label comes straight to this address, under reference Shop····.

I will not leave it at that. If it is still not with you, I will come back to you on it rather than wait for you to ask.

Kind regards,
Sarah
